combat.ashesSub: Burned away — each fed the lantern an ember
combat.facetsBody: 每個生物皆是琉璃。造成未被格擋的流血會琢下一格璃面；填滿量表則琉璃[b]碎裂[/b]——它失去下一動、陷入裂痕，並將餘燼灑入你的提燈。
combat.lanternBody: 提燈盛放碎裂與擊殺所灑的餘燼。將任意卡牌拖上即可燃燼——焚去該牌換取一點餘燼，每回合一次。詛咒拒火。
combat.staggeredTipBody: The glass has shattered — this creature loses its next action while it reseams.
combat.staggeredBody: 琉璃已碎——此生物在重新接合前失去下一動。

help.climbBody: 沿提燈之路攀向尖塔。擊敗怪物、收集卡牌、遺物與藥瓶，並打倒每一幕的首領，共 {count} 幕。未燃之燈隱匿其所藏——但點燃者須付賞金。
help.combatBody: 每回合你抽 5 張牌並獲得 3 點能量（⬤）。點擊或拖曳出牌——若場上尚有多名敵人，攻擊須選定目標。敵人頭頂會預示其意圖。
help.firesBody: 休息處可回復 30% 生命或升級一張牌。商店販售卡牌、遺物、藥瓶——亦可自牌庫中移除一張。保持牌庫精簡；每份戰利皆可放棄。
help.glassBody: 每個生物皆是琉璃，生命條下有一列璃面。造成未被格擋的傷害會琢下一格璃面（重擊琢得更多）。填滿量表則琉璃碎裂：它失去下一動、陷入裂痕，並將餘燼灑入你的提燈。把握碎裂時機，可擋下你無法承受的一擊。
help.lanternBody: 餘燼驅動你的提燈術——專屬力量，每回合可用一次（按 A）。將任意卡牌拖到提燈上即可燃燼：牌被焚去，提燈得 1 餘燼。每回合一次；詛咒拒火。
help.title: 玩法說明
help.vigilBody: 一無所費。每次攀行之初，掌燈人贈予恩賜並讓你選擇提燈術。倒下時，將一事刻入石中——一座紀念碑，下一行可在同一幕取回。每次碎裂、燃燼與擊殺皆累積畢生功績，解鎖新牌、遺物，與第二面向——灰衛。抵達破曉一次後，誓言開啟：一條可選的嚴酷難度之梯。
help.wardBody: 護光是可吸收傷害的持光，但每回合開始消散。裂痕 ×1.5 受傷 · 黯淡 −25% 輸出 · 脆裂 −25% 護光 · 陰燃每回合灼燒，宿主死亡或碎裂時躍至另一敵人。

venomStrike.name: 餘燼噬
venomStrike.text: 造成 @4@ 點傷害。 施加 3 層陰燃。
venomStrike.textUp: 造成 @6@ 點傷害。 施加 4 層陰燃。

virulence.name: 餘燼牙
virulence.text: Whenever you play an Attack, apply 1 Smolder to the enemy.

warCry.name: 碎裂聖詠
warCry.text: 施加 1 Dimmed and 1 Cracked to 所有敵人.
warCry.textUp: 施加 2 Dimmed and 2 Cracked to 所有敵人.

wound.name: Shard
wound.text: Unplayable. Broken glass rattling in your deck.

ashSermon.desc: 讓陰燃奪去 10 條性命
ashSermon.name: 灰燼佈道

spendthrift.desc: 施展提燈術耗用 30 點餘燼
spendthrift.name: 火贈無吝

untouched.desc: 毫髮無傷贏得 3 場戰鬥
untouched.name: 琉璃無痕

0.label: Take it
0.sub: Gain a relic. Gain a Hex.

cursedIdol.name: The Cursed Idol
cursedIdol.text: A jade idol sits on a plinth of skulls, radiating a soft warmth. It has clearly been left here for a reason.

emberFountain.name: Fountain of Embers
emberFountain.text: Liquid light pools in a cracked basin, throwing sparks that do not burn. It smells of summer and old victories.

0.label: Trade
0.sub: Lose 8 Max HP. Gain a relic.

fleshTrader.name: The Flesh Trader
fleshTrader.text: "Vitality is a currency," purrs a thing wearing a merchant's coat. "And you look flush with it." Long fingers open to reveal a relic.

forge.name: The Forgotten Forge
forge.text: An anvil of black star-metal, still warm. Hammers hang in racks, waiting for hands that died an age ago.

0.label: Pray
0.sub: Remove a card from your deck.

forgottenShrine.name: Forgotten Shrine
forgottenShrine.text: A moss-eaten shrine hums with old power. Offerings of bone and silver litter its base. Something watches from inside the stone.

gambler.name: The Bone Gambler

lose.text: The bones rattle against you. The wager is lost.

win.text: The bones land in your favour. You claim 110 gold.

gambler.text: A grinning figure rattles a cup of knuckle-bones. "One throw, stranger. Fortune loves the reckless."

0.label: Study
0.sub: Choose 1 of 5 cards to add to your deck.

library.name: The Drowned Library
library.text: Shelves of waterlogged grimoires stretch into the dark. Most are pulp — but a few pages still glow faintly.

0.label: Reflect
0.sub: Duplicate a card in your deck.

1.label: Shatter it
1.sub: Lose 6 HP. Remove a card from your deck.

mirror.name: The Silvered Mirror
mirror.text: A tall mirror stands in the rubble, unbroken. Your reflection moves half a breath behind you — and it is smiling.

1.label: Scavenge
1.sub: Gain 45 gold and a random potion.

ruinedCamp.name: Ruined Camp
ruinedCamp.text: A campfire, still smoldering. Bedrolls, torn. Whoever slept here left in a hurry — and left their packs behind.

0.label: Open it
0.sub: It might hold a relic... or teeth.

voidChest.name: Humming Chest
voidChest.text: A black iron chest sits alone in the gloom, humming a note you feel in your teeth. Its lock is already broken.

0.label: Aid him
0.sub: Lose 8 HP. He rewards you with a relic.

woundedKnight.name: The Wounded Knight
woundedKnight.text: A knight slumps against a shattered pillar, breath rattling behind a crushed visor. One gauntlet clutches a relic; the other beckons you closer.

ashfall.name: 灰落
ashfall.text: 灰燼噎滅每團火：敵人開戰時帶有 2 層陰燃，但其攻擊亦會在你身上留下 1 層陰燃。

eighthOmen.name: 第八凶兆
eighthOmen.text: 每場尋常戰鬥皆有題名。破碎的字句追隨每一層路。

emberWind.name: 餘燼之風
emberWind.text: 火星乘風入燈：每場戰鬥開始時獲得 2 點餘燼，但只抽 4 張牌，而非 5 張。

heavyAir.name: 沉光之氣
heavyAir.text: 空氣如水般托住光芒：你與敵人獲得的所有護光皆提高四分之一。

hungryDark.name: 飢渴長暗
hungryDark.text: 黑暗吞金，卻磨亮選擇：商店價格提高四分之一，卡牌獎賞則多提供 1 個選項。

longNight.name: 漫漫長夜
longNight.text: 朝聖之路延綿不盡：敵人生命提高 12%，但每場勝利多付 40% 金幣。

thinGlass.name: 薄璃之夜
thinGlass.text: 今夜所有琉璃皆薄：每道璃面量表少 1 格，但敵人攻擊傷害提高 2。

waningMoon.name: 殘月
waningMoon.text: 月亮把最後一縷光贈你：每回合打出的第一張牌少耗 1 點能量，但休息處只回復 20% 生命。

fire.name: 風暴琉璃藥瓶
fire.text: 對一名敵人造成 20 點傷害。

venom.name: 陰燃藥瓶
venom.text: 對一名敵人施加 7 層陰燃。

eighthOmen.inscription: Reach dawn beneath the Eighth Omen.
eighthOmen.name: The Eighth Omen
eighthOmen.resolved: THE EIGHTH OMEN WAS NEVER AN OMEN. IT WAS THE SHADOW OF A DOOR.

hollowLamplighter.inscription: Pay the Hollow Lamplighter five prices along the Unlit Way.

meetings.accepted: The next three embers belong to the hollow lantern.
meetings.ask: Your lantern is noisy. Give me the next three embers it catches.
meetings.cannot: Promise the embers now. The lantern will pay before you do.
meetings.paid: Six panes were carried away from a window no wall could hold.

meetings.ask: Gold remembers every hand. Let one hundred and sixty pieces forget yours.
meetings.cannot: Your purse is warm, but not warm enough.
meetings.paid: The Pale Ones watch the paths that point above the crown.

meetings.ask: The Spire counts the vessel. Give me twelve measures of yours.
meetings.cannot: I will not hollow you below thirty. Return with a larger vessel.
meetings.paid: Your standing dead have seen the stair above the Sovereign.

meetings.ask: The first keeper gave you a boon. Give me the gift, not the gratitude.
meetings.cannot: You have spent the gift already. Bring me one that is still yours.
meetings.paid: The empty lantern is the token that purchases an audience with the mask.

meetings.ask: Last price: leave this lantern with one heartbeat. The rest belongs to the dark.
meetings.cannot: One heartbeat is enough. Refusal is the only poverty left.
meetings.paid: Light the panes. The door will know you.

hollowLamplighter.name: The Hollow Lamplighter

ownShade.final: We were never climbing out. We were carrying light to the lock.
fragments: I remember the stone. You walked away before I stopped calling.
Each climber leaves a shape behind. The Spire has learned to wear ours.
Above the Sovereign there is no dawn — only a door pretending to be the sky.
ownShade.inscription: Defeat the self that remembers falling. Three shades must fall.
ownShade.name: Your Own Shade

paleOnes.huntInscription: Defeat three pale foes and follow the cold motes they leave behind.
paleOnes.inscription: Hunt the Pale Ones. Gather nine motes from glass that has forgotten colour.
paleOnes.name: The Pale Ones
progress: The first pale mote chills the lantern.

unreadablePage.inscription: Win five dawns carrying the Unreadable Page.
unreadablePage.name: The Unreadable Page
pages: FIRST PAGE — Six panes were cut from one fire, then scattered before the first Vigil.
SECOND PAGE — Pale figures carried the shards down so the thing above could not follow.
THIRD PAGE — A climber died standing and saw a stair where the summit should have ended.
FOURTH PAGE — The Sovereign took an empty lantern and wore a king's shape over the lock.
FIFTH PAGE — The Rose Window is a map, not a memorial. Light it, then look above the crown.

usurper.bought: Now the summit knows what you carry.
usurper.death: The mask is broken. Look above.
usurper.inscription: Carry the lantern with no flame to the summit and unmask the Usurper.
usurper.itemText: Cold glass. No wick. The merchant will not say who left it.
usurper.name: The Usurper
usurper.poor: Cold goods, warm price. Come back carrying a dawn's worth of gold.

ashenCore.name: Ashen Core
ashenCore.text: Enemies begin each combat with 3 Smolder.

bellOfEndings.name: Bell of Endings
bellOfEndings.text: Whenever glass Shatters, every other enemy takes 4 damage.

crownOfCinders.name: Crown of Cinders
crownOfCinders.text: Your lantern holds 12 Embers and begins each combat holding 2.

crownOfTheHearth.name: Crown of the Hearth
crownOfTheHearth.text: At the end of combat, heal 3 HP for every Ember still in your lantern.

crownOfTithes.name: Crown of Tithes
crownOfTithes.text: You may kindle twice each turn, and each kindling grants 3 Ward.

duskmirror.name: Duskmirror
duskmirror.text: The first card you play each turn costs 0.

emberHeart.name: Emberheart
emberHeart.text: At the end of combat, heal 3 HP.

emberLantern.name: Ember Lantern
emberLantern.text: Gain 1 extra Energy on your first turn.

executionersSeal.name: Executioner's Seal
executionersSeal.text: Every 10th Attack you play deals double damage.

frozenCore.name: Frozen Core
frozenCore.text: Unspent Energy carries over between turns.

gravebloom.name: Gravebloom
gravebloom.text: After combat, if at or below 50% HP, heal 10.

hollowCrown.name: Hollow Crown
hollowCrown.text: Gain 1 Energy each turn. The glass dims: on pickup, lose 10 Max HP.

ironTalisman.name: Iron Talisman
ironTalisman.text: Every 3rd Attack you play grants 1 Fervor.

prismCharm.name: Prism Charm
prismCharm.text: Your first Shatter each combat spills 2 extra Embers.

reapersBell.name: Reaper's Bell
reapersBell.text: When an enemy dies, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.

shatterersCrown.name: Shatterer's Crown
shatterersCrown.text: Enemy glass runs thin: all facet gauges are 1 smaller. Enemies begin with 1 Fervor.

silkFan.name: Silk Fan
silkFan.text: Every 3rd card you play each combat grants 3 Ward.

smolderingCoal.name: Smoldering Coal
smolderingCoal.text: Enemies begin each combat with 2 Smolder.

travelersPack.name: Traveler's Pack
travelersPack.text: Draw 2 extra cards on your first turn.

verdantBranch.name: Verdant Branch
verdantBranch.text: Whenever a card is Kindled or burned away, draw 1 card.

vialOfLife.name: Vial of Life
vialOfLife.text: Heal 2 HP at the start of each combat.

wardingCharm.name: Warding Charm
wardingCharm.text: Enemy attacks that would deal 5 or less damage deal 1.

beacon.desc: Attacks chip N extra Facet(s). Fades at end of turn.
beacon.name: Beacon

emberflow.desc: Gain N Ember(s) at the start of each turn.
emberflow.name: Pyreheart

energized.desc: Gain N extra Energy at the start of each turn.
energized.name: Alight

frail.desc: Ward gained reduced 25%. Wears off each turn.
frail.name: 脆裂

metallicize.desc: Gains N Ward at the end of each turn.
metallicize.name: Vitrified

nightsight.desc: Draw N extra card(s) at the start of each turn.
nightsight.name: Night Sight

poison.desc: Burns from within: loses N HP at the start of its turn, then Smolder falls by 1. When smoldering glass shatters or dies, the Smolder leaps to another enemy.
poison.name: 陰燃

rampage.desc: Attack grows stronger with each use.
rampage.name: Crescendo

regen.desc: Heals N HP at the end of each turn.
regen.name: Warmth

ritual.desc: Gains N Fervor at the start of each turn.
ritual.name: Litany

str.desc: The inner fire stoked: attacks deal +N damage.
str.name: 熾心

vulnerable.desc: The glass is scored: takes 50% more attack damage. Wears off each turn.
vulnerable.name: 裂痕

weak.desc: The fire gutters: deals 25% less attack damage. Wears off each turn.
weak.name: 黯淡

ownShade1.deathDialogue: 我記得那塊石。你轉身離去時，我仍未停止呼喚。
ownShade1.name: 墜落之影

ownShade2.deathDialogue: 每位朝聖者都留下一道形影。尖塔已學會披上我們的模樣。
ownShade2.name: 歸來之影

ownShade3.deathDialogue: 王座之上沒有破曉——只有一扇偽裝成天空的門。
ownShade3.name: 銘記之影

dialogue: {aspect}。終於，提燈為我帶來一個名字。
永恆君王只是一副面具。你已付出代價，得見其下真容。
打碎我，無焰提燈自會記起火光。
usurpedSovereign.name: 篡位者

0.desc: 每隻生物更難打破——敵人生命 +12%。
0.name: 鐵之誓

1.desc: 敵人的重擊更沉——敵人攻擊傷害 +1。
1.name: 惡意之誓

2.desc: 首領以甲守護核心——首領璃面 +1。
2.name: 深淵之誓

3.desc: 起行時已受詛咒——每次朝聖皆以一張咒印牌開始。
3.name: 烙印之誓

4.desc: 黑暗啜飲你的休憩——營火回復 20% 生命，而非 30%。
4.name: 殘月之誓

whispers: 有一種顏色，尖塔拒絕為它命名。
一隻蒼白的手觸過璃的暗面。
六處空位在等候，那裡不曾立過窗。
死者攀行兩次：一次以肉身，一次以記憶。
無焰的提燈仍是一把鑰匙。
數一數接不住破曉的窗格。
一頁字，唯有在頂點倖存之後才能讀。
第八徵兆不寫在七者之中。
憔悴的守門人記得你未走的路。
蒼白微粒如霜，聚在隱縫周圍。
你的紀念碑並不總是躺下。
商人櫃下藏著一件冰冷之物。
破碎符文是完整句子的影子。
五頁成章；五次代價成供認。
三次死亡會教你的影子說明白話。
守夜有一扇窗，雖無牆承載它。
每片碎片點亮一格餘燼琉璃。
蒼白者並非在獵你。他們在向上指。
主宰是戴在最終階下的面具。
當六扇窗燃起，望向頂點之外。
王冠之上有一扇封印之門。
它的銘文等候得比守夜更久。
帶六片碎片到玫瑰窗。
攀行仍在繼續。
